result.title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
result.summary: Fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning (FG-FSCIL) aims to incrementally learn visually similar new classes from limited images without catastrophic forgetting. Prior work typically learns strong representations on base classes or leverages vision foundation models (VFMs) directly as backbones or via knowledge distillation. However, VFM backbones incur high computational costs and do not guarantee fine-grained recognition. Although knowledge distillation reduces inference cost, our preliminary experiments reveal that distilled students still lag substantially behind their VFM teachers, particularly on new classes. To address this limitation, we propose STAND, a systematic VFM-to-student distillation design tailored for FG-FSCIL. Specifically, STAND connects the teacher and student by equipping the student with a fixed copy of the teacher's classifier, aligning their outputs via projectors, and feeding both models composite images that combine different training images. On these composite images, relation distillation matches how the teacher and the student relate each image to other images, while difference distillation matches how this relation changes between two composite images. Finally, we freeze the student and classify new classes using length-calibrated prototypes, which restore the reduced similarity of few-shot prototypes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that STAND achieves state-of-the-art performance across FG-FSCIL datasets at low computational cost, while generalizing across student backbones and broader datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 针对细粒度少样本类增量学习，提出 STAND：让学生复用教师分类器、用投影器对齐输出，并在合成图像上同时做关系蒸馏与差值蒸馏，最后用长度校准原型分类新类，以低计算成本接近 VFM 教师。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关系/差值蒸馏对齐师生对图像间关系及关系变化的表征，以及校准少样本原型相似度的做法，可能可供核查 VLM 内部视觉细节保留与 latent 相似度偏差问题，但论文本身是分类式增量学习，不涉及推理期状态生成或证据使用。
